s: The CAST Rule says that in quadrant I all three of \(\sin\theta\text{,}\) \(\cos\theta\text{,}\) \(\tan\theta\) are positive. In quadrant II, only \(\sin\theta\) is positive, while \(\cos\theta\text{,}\) \(\tan\theta\) are negative. In quadrant III, only \(\tan\theta\) is positive, while \(\sin\theta\text{,}\) \(\cos\theta\) are negative.
